# Verifies a user-defined func that mutates state from outside a direct
# event handler still triggers DOM updates. Tests legacy g.updates
# findAffectedUpdaters dispatch from emitSetter.
#
# Legacy pipeline emits:
#   - emitted user func body inlines per-assignment DOM patches:
#       function update(newName, newCount) {
#         state.name = newName;
#         __n0.textContent = state.name;
#         state.count = newCount;
#         __n1.textContent = String(state.count);
#       }
#   - g.updates also emits the per-node updaters $u__n0_text / $u__n1_text
#     and a click handler that calls update("Hello", 5).
#
# NOTE: legacy does NOT emit a separate $set_name(v) function — mutations
# are inlined at each assignment site within the user func. Plan D Task
# 10+ needs to preserve this inlined-dispatch semantics.

sngl compile --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# User func is emitted with both state mutations and inlined DOM patches.
grep 'function update' out/index.html
grep 'state.name = newName' out/index.html
grep 'state.count = newCount' out/index.html
grep '__n0.textContent = state.name' out/index.html
grep '__n1.textContent = String\(state.count\)' out/index.html

# Per-node updaters still emitted for initial sync.
grep '\$u__n0_text' out/index.html
grep '\$u__n1_text' out/index.html

# Button click handler calls user func.
grep 'update\("Hello", 5\)' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "World"
    var count int = 0

    func update(newName string, newCount int) {
        name = newName
        count = newCount
    }

    text(value=name)
    text(value=string(count))
    button(text="Update", @click { update("Hello", 5) })
}
